returnConventions.totalReturn: Adjusted closes, dividends reinvested at the adjustment basis
returnConventions.priceReturn: Split-adjusted closes with cash dividends retained and no reinvestment

methodology.weighting: score x (point-in-time outstanding-share market cap / median) ^ 0.5 with 9% stock and 35% sector-group caps (research proxy; historical float shares unavailable)
methodology.size_input: point-in-time share count x unadjusted close
methodology.historical_capitalisation: point-in-time share count x unadjusted close; research proxy, not float-adjusted
methodology.weighting_limitation: Historical float-share counts are unavailable; the point-in-time outstanding-share cap proxy cannot validate the production float-cap rule.

dividendCoverage.convention: Total return uses adjusted closes. Dividend-exclusive return uses split-adjusted closes, retains cash on each ex-date, and does not purchase additional shares.

dataQuality.forward_fill_policy: Prices are carried only across provider holes; a tail beyond 5 sessions makes the backtest unavailable.
